data.title: Master plan for the South up to board
data.description: The cabinet has approved letting a southern development board draft a regional master plan, shifting the focus from the proposed Land Bridge megaproject to transport connectivity, economic development and public participation.

data.title: Jeno and Jaemin ready for  BKK fan meet this weekend
data.description: The subunit NCT JNJM with Jeno and Jaemin, formed by SM Entertainment, turned out to be a massive success.

data.title: Navy rejects claims over bunker safety
data.description: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) has rejected claims that border bunkers in Chanthaburi and Trat are unsafe or poorly built, saying photographs circulated online showed unfinished construction and did not reflect the overall condition of the facilities.

data.title: 60bn gold card budget reviewed
data.description: A review of 60 billion baht from the 2025 universal healthcare budget is under way, says Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat, after he questioned whether the money had been properly allocated.

data.title: Ukraine looks ahead to post-war rebuild riches
data.description: Ukraine is encouraging Thai businesses to invest in the country as bilateral relations continue to expand despite the conflict, the Ukrainian embassy said.

data.title: Thais on the march in the Philippines
data.description: Thailand edged closer to the semi‑finals of the Asean Hyundai Cup with a late strike from Waris Choolthong that secured a 1‑0 victory over the Philippines in New Clark City on Tuesday night.

data.title: Interpol alert leads to arrest of Swedish woman
data.description: PHUKET: A Swedish woman wanted under an Interpol Red Notice for fraud was arrested after hiding in Thailand while evading prosecution over a call centre scam that caused losses exceeding 60 million baht, police said.

data.title: Ministry checks health record complaints
data.description: The Public Health Ministry has reviewed 30% of 16,350 complaints over incorrect Mor Prom health records, with most cases linked to data entry errors.

data.title: Dinosaur fossils unearthed
data.description: More than 100 dinosaur fossil fragments estimated to be over 130 million years old have been found in Chaiyaphum, raising hopes of identifying one of Thailand's oldest known carnivorous dinosaurs.

data.title: Women seek help over explicit videos allegedly by policeman
data.description: A group of women have sought legal help after accusing a Songkhla police officer of forcing victims to record explicit videos and allegedly selling them online, with the youngest victim aged four.

data.title: Bitkub in SEC sights over hack
data.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) submitted additional evidence to police over allegations Bitkub Online concealed a 2021 digital asset hack worth 1.7 billion baht.

data.title: Reformists oppose delay to board poll
data.description: A social security reform group on Wednesday petitioned the Central Administrative Court to revoke the postponement of the Social Security Board election. It argued that election officials had misinterpreted an earlier court order and delayed the entire process without sufficient legal grounds.

data.title: WHO chief urges stronger Ebola response in DR Congo visit
data.description: KINSHASA - The head of the World Health Organization on Wednesday urged authorities to step up the Ebola response and better protect frontline health workers, during a visit to the DR Congo where a deadly outbreak is spreading fast.

data.title: Rail ties with Russia advance
data.description: Thailand and Russia have pledged to strengthen railway ties after transport officials from both countries met in Moscow on Wednesday to discuss technology cooperation, skills development and research partnerships.

data.title: Turkish MPs back limited amnesty for Kurdish militants
data.description: ANKARA - A majority of Turkish MPs on Wednesday backed limited and conditional amnesty for PKK Kurdish militants, a first legislative step to end decades of deadly fighting.

data.title: Stern test from within
data.description: Less than four months after taking office, the government appears to be confronting the greatest threat to its survival -- not from an emboldened opposition, but from mounting pressures within its own ranks.

data.title: Govt shows unity amid rumours
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Pheu Thai leader Julapun Amornvivat put on a public display of unity on Tuesday, dismissing speculation the ruling coalition could fracture ahead of an expected no-confidence debate later this year.

data.title: Min Aung Hlaing talks to address bilateral challenges
data.description: Thailand and Myanmar are preparing to to discuss border security, transnational crime, trade recovery and peace efforts during Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing’s official visit to Thailand on Thursday and Friday.

data.title: Tiger attack on ranger only ‘second in 28 years’
data.description: A tiger that killed and dragged away a park ranger in Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary was behind only the second known attack of its kind in 28 years, and the behaviour was not typical of the species, the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) said on Wednesday.

data.title: Three state agency accounts frozen after vehicle data leaks
data.description: Three government agency user accounts with access to the Ministry of Transport database have been suspended after authorities detected suspicious activities, Deputy Transport Minister Siripong Angkasakulkiat said on Wednesday.

data.title: ‘Explosive drone’ found at German airport
data.description: BERLIN - German police raised the alarm at an airport overnight after an explosives-laden drone was found near a Ukrainian cargo plane and another aircraft collided with an unknown flying object in mid-air nearby before landing safely.

data.title: “Legally Blonde: The Musical” delivers high-energy laughs
data.description: Singapore Repertory Theatre’s Legally Blonde: The Musical delivers high-energy comedy, catchy songs and a standout all-Singaporean cast.

data.description: Unveiling the “Happy & Healthy Mall” Strategy: Transforming Makro and Lotus’s retail locations into happy community spaces for people of all generations. Advance the development of 60 projects across 29 provinces nationwide in 2026–2027, marking one of the Company’s largest mall development and renovation programmes in recent years. Developing four Happy & Healthy Mall Models built on the core principle of “Understanding Each Community” to fit the unique context of every location nationwide.

data.title: S. Khonkaen Strengthens Entrée Brand with “Meet & Chips” Campaign Featuring Tle–FirstOne
data.description: S. Khonkaen Foods Public Company Limited (SORKON) continues to advance the marketing strategy of its Entrée brand through the “Entrée Meet & Chips: เติมโปรตีน ฟินคู่ชิปส์ with Tle & Firstone” campaign. The exclusive event offered selected campaign winners an opportunity to meet the brand’s two presenters up close, participate in special activities, and receive exclusive prizes in a fun-filled atmosphere that received an overwhelmingly warm response. The event further reinforced Entrée’s positioning as a high-protein snack brand that fits seamlessly into the lifestyles of today’s younger consumers.

data.title: TFM Posts Strong Q2 Growth, Declares THB 0.18 Interim Dividend
data.description: BANGKOK – 31 July 2026 – Thai Union Feedmill Public Company Limited, or TFM, reported strong operating results for the second quarter of 2026, with revenue increasing by 9.8% and net profit rising by 9.0% from the previous quarter. This performance brought the Company’s first-half sales revenue to THB 2.78 billion and net profit to THB 308 million, driven primarily by its shrimp feed business. TFM also announced an interim dividend payment of THB 0.18 per share, scheduled for 26 August 2026.

data.title: Cabinet backs revised Myanmar labour pact
data.description: Revised labour agreements with Myanmar are aimed at strengthening protections for migrant workers and ensuring cross-border recruitment is conducted through legal channels, a deputy government spokesperson said on Wednesday.
